featured.subtitle: AI assistance for German official communication — from confusing letters to clear next steps.
featured.body: GovMate AI helps people living in Germany understand and respond to official correspondence from Jobcenter, Ausländerbehörde, Finanzamt, Krankenkasse and related institutions. Upload a document, get a plain-language explanation, track deadlines, and generate a professional German reply.

about.location: Building products across web, AI and automation.
about.title: A developer focused on useful systems — not empty demos.
about.lead: I design and ship digital products with clear interfaces, reliable architecture and a practical mindset.
about.p1: I like turning complicated ideas into simple digital products. Clarity is the craft.
about.p2: My work lives where web applications, AI, automation, APIs and cloud deployment meet. I care less about noise and more about software that people can trust in real workflows.
about.p3: At OstWind Group and in independent products like GovMate AI, I work end-to-end: product thinking, frontend quality, API design, data models and production delivery.
about.p4: I collaborate well in agile teams, take code review seriously, and stay motivated by solving problems that matter to real people in real systems.
about.principlesSubtitle: A small set of principles that keep products calm, usable and shippable.

clarity.title: Clarity first
clarity.body: Interfaces and architecture should explain themselves. If something needs a long apology, it usually needs a redesign.

reliability.title: Reliability over hype
reliability.body: I prefer stable delivery, tested paths and maintainable code over trends that break under real use.

shipping.title: Ship to production
shipping.body: A product only becomes useful when it reaches users. I build with deployment, monitoring and iteration in mind.

collaboration.title: Team-ready craft
collaboration.body: Clean pull requests, honest communication and reusable systems make collaboration faster for everyone.
